camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn Unicom --EndTime '2017-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --TimeMerge 1 --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2017-12-10T20:00:00Z' --FixTimeGap false --Interval 300
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData to query network bandwidth monitoring data for Layer 4 acceleration of accelerated domain names. You can query data from the last 90 days
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData获取加速域名四层加速的网络带宽监控数据，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-ipa-bps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --time-merge 1 --interval 300 --fix-time-gap false --isp-name-en Unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainIpaBpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name.

You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, data for all accelerated domain names is queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名。

多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔，默认查询所有加速域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically adjust the time granularity. If you set this parameter to 1, an appropriate value for the Interval parameter is used based on the specified StartTime and EndTime. You can specify either this parameter or the Interval parameter
parameters.help_zh: 是否自适应计算Interval值，如果timeMerge=1，会根据startTime和endTime计算出合适的inteval值，和Interval参数任选
parameters.name: time_merge

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data to query, in seconds.

The valid values for this parameter depend on the time span between StartTime and EndTime:

If the time span is less than 3 days: 300, 3600, and 86400 are supported. The default value is 300.

If the time span is from 3 to 31 days (exclusive): 3600 and 86400 are supported. The default value is 3600.

If the time span is 31 days or more: 86400 is supported. The default value is 86400
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位为秒。

根据您指定StartTime和EndTime两者的时间跨度，该参数取值如下：

3天以内（不包含3天整）：支持300、3600、 86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为300。

3~31天（不包含31天整）：支持3600和86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为3600。

31天及以上：支持86400，如果不传该参数，默认值为86400
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pad data with zeros. Valid values:

true: Pads data with zeros.

false: Does not pad data with zeros
parameters.help_zh:
是否补零。取值：
true：补零。
false：不补零
parameters.name: fix_time_gap

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the carrier. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query the English name. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all carriers is queried.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation, which queries all carriers by default
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation to query the English name. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all regions is queried.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html operation. By default, all regions are queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207199.html接口获取，默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between data points. Unit: seconds

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
